thread:
ada: quick onefound mismatch on /v1/rerank docs. Schema shows `{ \"query\": string, \"documents\": [string] }` but the examples use a bare array `[{...}, {...}]`. This makes the cURL/JS snippets invalid and our snippet-lint is flagging it in support reproductions.

 tom: ugh. Which shape does the server expect now?

 ada: server expects the object wrapper (query + documents). We used to accept a top-level array for historical reasons but we removed that last month. Docs should show the canonical object.

 nirav: ok. So we should: 1) change all examples (curl, JS, python, go) to send `{\"query\": \"...\", \"documents\": [...]}`; 2) update the schema block to be explicit and add an example JSON block; 3) fix the cURL header (add `-H \"Content-Type: application/json\"`).

 julia: small additional nit: the JS fetch example uses `body: JSON.stringify(documents)` (i.e. the bare array) and forgets `headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }` so it fails in browsers. I'll patch the snippet to `JSON.stringify({ query, documents })` and include the header.

 tom: also the Go sample constructs `var docs = []string{"a","b"}` then calls `client.Rerank(docs)` in the snippet. Our Go SDK signature is `Rerank(ctx, payload)` expecting a struct. Please update the Go example to `client.Rerank(ctx, RerankRequest{Query: "...", Documents: docs})`.

 nirav: let's add a Migration note under the rerank page: 1) top-level array payload removed; 2) ensure `Content-Type` set for cURL/browser fetch; 3) SDKs have typed request structs now. Keep it short.

 ada: I'll open a single PR that updates the schema block, all snippets (curl/js/py/go), adds a tiny test `tests/fixtures/rerank-object-payload.json`, and runs `./scripts/snippet-lint` locally.

 julia: thanks. Can you also grep for `Rerank(` in `docs/snippets` and `examples/` to make sure no old usage remains? I can help.

 tom: PR needs a note for release notes: breaking change for raw-array payloads (they now 400) and recommended code migrate snippet. @nirav can you write that line?

 nirav: yep 1: "Rerank endpoint now requires an object payload {query, documents}; bare-array payloads will return 400. Update calls to wrap with { query: ..., documents: [...] }."

 docs-bot: Draft PR opened by ada: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1184 (WIP)

 ada: pushed updates and fixed the JS header; running snippet-lint now. If all green I'll remove WIP label.

 julia: reviewed and added tiny Go snippet fix. All examples render locally.

 tom: LGTM. Merge after CI and a single reviewer approval.

 docs-bot: PR merged by ada: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1184 :tada:
